opening.argument: The presentation provides a practical walkthrough of Paytm Gold rather than presenting an outcome as guaranteed. Viewers are shown how recurring purchases can be arranged, including the explanation that “if we want to buy 1 grams gold every month we can do that,” while the app screens display options to buy, sell, and obtain delivery of virtual gold. The discussion also addresses possible benefit or loss and cautions that “gold price fluctuates everyday,” emphasizing market knowledge and risk. Although future prices and possible profit are discussed, the speaker states they are not making a purchase at that time. This is ordinary instructional information about app-based gold features and delivery, without evidence of deceptive conduct.
